newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to continue U.S. support of World Bank.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to continue U.S. support of World Bank.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Saturday stressed anew America's commitment for continued support for the World Bank and other international financial institutions.
Rubin said the commitment came during a day-long session with President Bill Clinton and his incoming and outgoing Cabinet officers.
He said the group emphasized the importance of continuing to support economic development "through the World Bank and at sister banks and having adequate funding for those institutions."
He said the group also stressed the importance of continuing momentum toward "opening markets around the world."
The integral role of economic policy to foreign policy, including China and Russia, was also discussed, he told reporters.
